notes: Development controls evaluated separately from the earlier nine-case multi-seed suite.
Two distinct training runs share seed 42, the data split, and initialization settings with the reference; learning rates are 0.0008 and 0.0012 instead of 0.001.
Health criteria were declared before training and diagnosis: accuracy shortfall at most 0.03 and validation-loss ratio at most 1.25. Accuracy gain over a failed run is not applicable.
The selected reports are the first Agent invocations for these cases, using gemini-3.5-flash-lite with budgets of 6 model calls, 5 tool calls, and 2000 output tokens per model request.
Correct abstention requires no_supported_failure, no ranked causes, no proposed patch, and no repair report.
The reports speculate about stochastic variation without establishing the cause. Narrative causal faithfulness is not scored by these metrics; original reports are retained unchanged.
These paired controls are not independent statistical trials or a held-out benchmark. No population false-positive rate is inferred from two cases.
